description: This file defines and implements the 'CalendarAccountViewList' class, which extends from 'ViewList'. It appears to customize the list view behavior for calendar accounts in the SuiteCRM application, configuring properties such as export capability, display messages, mass update, and user permissions.

classes.name: CalendarAccountViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to customize list view behavior for calendar accounts, disabling export, mass updates, and modifying delete permissions based on user roles.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Prepares the list view by configuring display properties and user permissions, disables export, mass update, and delete for non-admin users.
